en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide view over a calm body of water, seen from a wooded foreground hillside. On the opposite shore lies a small settlement with scattered houses and a prominent white church with a tower, backed by densely forested hills. A few small boats are visible on the water. Printed white caption text appears along the bottom left, and a small publisher's logo with the number 7809 is at the bottom right.
